description:
Spun off from bd:JMAP-26di.52 which originally scoped this to three
chat-client wire enums. Broader scope: every wire enum in the workspace
that uses jmap_types::impl_string_enum! shares the same forging caveat —
the pub Other(String) variant lets callers construct
Other("canonical-wire-string".into()), which:

* Compares unequal to the canonical variant on PartialEq.
* Serialises to the canonical wire string.
* Round-trips back to the canonical variant on deserialize.

Workspace census (grep impl_string_enum! across crate-jmap-*-types/
and crate-jmap-chat-client/, excluding the macro definition itself):
19 invocations. Each one carries the same footgun:

- jmap-types::string_enum.rs (tests)
- jmap-mail-types: MailboxRole, ComparatorProperty (×N), Delivered, Displayed, UndoStatus
- jmap-chat-types: Presence, UrgencyLevel, DeliveryState, ReadDisposition, ChatKind
- jmap-filenode-types: NodeType, NodeRole
- jmap-tasks-types: NotificationType, TaskListRole, TaskProgress
- jmap-calendars-types: NotificationType
- jmap-sharing-types: (1 enum)
- jmap-chat-client: QuotaScope, ChatMemberRole, BodyType

Options:

1. Document the footgun on the impl_string_enum! macro's rustdoc and
   reference it from every using site (low cost, low protection).
2. Have the macro generate a `pub fn other(s: impl Into<String>) -> Self`
   canonicalising constructor for every enum, then encourage callers to
   use it. Does not block direct construction of Other(...) — partial
   protection.
3. Change the macro to generate a private newtype OpaqueOther around
   the String, with a public constructor that canonicalises. Airtight
   but a sizable API redesign with public-API breakage for any consumer
   that currently matches on Other(s).

bd:JMAP-26di.52 applied option 1 at chat-client scope (rustdoc on each
Other variant). This bead tracks lifting that to the macro itself plus
the parallel docs on every using site, and/or escalating to option 2/3.

The bead is workspace-template-shaped and should be filed under a
workspace canonical-template propagation epic (or JMAP-x2gd if active),
not under JMAP-26di which is the chat-client-specific review epic.
title: impl_string_enum! forging caveat is systemic across 19 workspace wire enums
